major_issues.issue: Figure 1 裁剪严重不完整：仅截到图注和 'Taxol' 字样加苯环角，从 DMAPP/TS/GGPP → taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene → taxadiene-5α-ol → taxadiene-5α-yl acetate → T13αH/T9αH… → Taxol 的完整路径示意图整体缺失，读者无法看到任何 Figure 1 的核心信息（酶步骤、化学骨架、产物编号 1/2/3）。
major_issues.source_locator: PDF physical page 2, Figure 1 (整页下方约 1/3 区域)
major_issues.correction: 将裁剪框调整为覆盖整张 Figure 1 含图体与图注，建议 normalized bbox ≈ [0.04, 0.40, 0.96, 0.79]；图注（'Fig. 1 Scheme of Taxol biosynthesis…'）已包含在原页 2 底部，需保证 DMAPP→IPP→GGPP→TS→taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene→T5αH/CPR→taxadiene-5α-ol→T5A→Taxol 全图均在图内。

major_issues.issue: Figure 3 裁剪缺失左侧每行的融合蛋白标签（tp(TS)/GFP、TS/GFP、tp(T5αH)/GFP、T5αH/GFP、tp(TS)/trT5αH/trCPR/CFP）以及右侧图注末段；这是识别各 panel 所用构建的唯一线索，目前仅靠残留的 'a/b/c' 字母无法判断每行对应的融合蛋白。
major_issues.source_locator: PDF physical page 4, Figure 3（左栏约上半页）
major_issues.correction: 将裁剪框向左侧延伸以包含 tp(TS)/GFP…trT5αH/trCPR/CFP 行标签，并保留 Figure 3 图注全文；建议 normalized bbox ≈ [0.05, 0.04, 0.50, 0.55]，并下沿包含 'Fig. 3 Intracellular organelle localization…' 完整图注。

major_issues.issue: Figure 5 裁剪左侧 Y 轴标签 'Relative expression'（panel a）与 'Taxadiene (μg g⁻¹ FW)'（panel b、d）缺失，panel a/b/d 顶端的字母标签 'a'/'b'/'d' 被截掉，导致图例与坐标信息残缺。
major_issues.source_locator: PDF physical page 6, Figure 5（左栏柱状图）
major_issues.correction: 向左扩展裁剪以纳入 Y 轴标题 'Relative expression'、'Taxadiene (μg g⁻¹ FW)'、'Taxadiene isomers (μg g⁻¹ FW)'，并保留 'a/b/c/d/e' 面板字母；建议 normalized bbox ≈ [0.04, 0.04, 0.97, 0.88]（基本为整页 Figure 5 区域）。

major_issues.issue: Figure 4 与 Figure 6 裁剪中各面板字母 'a/b/c/d' 与 'a/b/c/d/e' 几乎完全缺失。Figure 4 crop 顶部 panel 标签未显；Figure 6 crop 仅能看到 bar chart 上方 'c'，图注中 a (pathway schematic)、b (constructs)、d (empty vector GC-MS)、e (combined GC-MS) 各自对应面板无法在图内一一对应定位。
major_issues.source_locator: PDF physical page 5 (Figure 4) 与 physical page 8 (Figure 6)
major_issues.correction: 扩大图顶空白，确保 'a/b/c/d' (Fig. 4) 与 'a/b/c/d/e' (Fig. 6) 字母保留在各自面板上方。建议 Fig. 4 normalized bbox ≈ [0.04, 0.04, 0.97, 0.63]；Fig. 6 normalized bbox ≈ [0.04, 0.04, 0.97, 0.73]。

minor_issues: 草稿正文叙述'整合实验 taxadiene 维持在 ~15–17 μg g⁻¹ FW'暗示该水平较叶绿体单独组（9.9 μg g⁻¹ FW）'维持'，但原文是显著升高；建议改为'协同提升至 ~15–17 μg g⁻¹ FW'，以避免暗示与单独组相当。

verified_claims.claim: taxadiene 56.6 μg g⁻¹ FW、taxadiene-5α-ol 1.3 μg g⁻¹ FW
verified_claims.evidence: the engineered plants can produce taxadiene and taxadiene-5α-ol, the committed taxol intermediates, at 56.6 μg g−1 FW and 1.3 μg g−1 FW, respectively

verified_claims.claim: TS-only 时间线 2 dpi ≈0.8、4 dpi 5.6±1.3、5 dpi 15.7±4.7 μg g⁻¹ FW
verified_claims.evidence: taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene initially accumulated at 2 dpi (about 0.8 μg g−1 fresh weight (FW) of tissues), significantly increased to almost 5.6 ± 1.3 μg g−1 at 4 dpi, and to 15.7 ± 4.7 μg g−1 at 5 dpi

verified_claims.claim: DXS+TS 提升 taxadiene 至 45.9 μg g⁻¹ FW (>8 倍)；GGPPS+TS 提升至 24.5 μg g⁻¹ FW (4 倍)
verified_claims.evidence: DXS increased taxadiene production by more than 8-folds, up to 45.9 μg g−1 FW … Co-expression of GGPPS also increased taxadiene production by 4-folds (24.5 μg g−1 FW)

verified_claims.claim: trTS-trT5αH/trCPR 胞质组 taxadiene-5α-ol 0.21 μg g⁻¹ FW；TS-tp(TS)/trT5αH/trCPR 叶绿体组 taxadiene 9.9 μg g⁻¹ FW、taxadiene-5α-ol 0.90 μg g⁻¹ FW (≈4.3 倍)
verified_claims.evidence: such truncations did not significantly increase taxadiene levels, but slightly enabled accumulation of taxadiene-5α-ol at a low level of 0.21 μg g−1 FW … there was an increase in the amount of taxadiene to 9.9 μg g−1 FW (about 2.0-fold higher than engineering in the cytoplasm), and a remarkable increase in taxadiene-5α-ol … to 0.90 μg g−1 FW (almost 4.3-fold increase)

verified_claims.claim: taxadiene-5α-ol:OCT:iso-OCT 比值 1:5:1.5（单独叶绿体）与 1:4:1.6（合并 DXS-GGPPS）

verified_claims.evidence: the ratio of taxadiene-5α-ol to OCT and iso-OCT were relatively unchanged at 1:5:1.5 … The ratio of taxadiene-5α-ol:OCT:iso-OCT in chloroplast-engineered lines (1:4:1.6) was nearly similar to that in cytosolic engineered-plants

verified_claims.claim: TS 含 58 aa 叶绿体转运肽；T5αH 42 aa、CPR 74 aa 跨膜区
verified_claims.evidence: TS possesses a putative chloroplastic targeting sequence with 58 amino acid residues at the N-terminus, while T5αH and CPR were predicted as membrane proteins … with 42 and 74 amino acid residues transmembrane region at their N-terminals

verified_claims.claim: fosmidomycin 150 μM 完全阻断；lovastatin 10 μM 使 taxadiene 自 15.7±3.2 降至 9.7±2.4 μg g⁻¹ FW (-40.1%)
verified_claims.evidence: the NTS1-T2 control lines could produce taxadiene at levels of 15.7 ± 3.2 μg g−1 FW while the MVA-inhibited plants decreased taxadiene production by 40.1% to the level of 9.7 ± 2.4 μg g−1 FW … Inhibition of the MEP pathway by fosmidomycin totally suppressed taxadiene biosynthesis
